caption: A car brakes on a rain-wet street at night, and red light from its brake lights spreads over the wet road behind it.

sa.check: A car is on a rain-wet street at night.
Red light from its brake lights spreads over the wet road behind it.
The glow lies behind the car, not in front.

pc.expect: The glow on the road is red and lies behind the car.
pc.fail: It is white; or lies in front; or is a colour the lights do not show.

pc.expect: The glow appears when the lights come on and would disappear when they go off.
pc.fail: It is there with the lights off; or the lights are on with no glow; or it stays after they go off.

pc.expect: The road is wet: the glow shimmers where puddles ripple and is absent where dry.
pc.fail: It is a sharp mirror image on rough tarmac; or shows on dry patches; or the water is rigid.

pc.expect: The glow moves only with the car.
pc.fail: It drifts with the car stopped; or flickers with steady lights; or moves ahead of the car.

pc.expect: One car and its two brake lights.
pc.fail: A light vanishes; or a third appears; or the car duplicates.

pc.expect: The car and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the street rearranges; or the buildings change.
